price_mapping.defect: The 5-Minute Context Reset Playbook (pri_01m23gzc9bb5z3kr0yfqrx7yba, $15) was live+active in Paddle but absent from data/paddle_products.json. A real transaction.completed for it would have been rejected as PRODUCT_MISMATCH, so a genuine paid sale could never be recorded, and the product was not offered on the public catalog.
price_mapping.repair: added the real live product_id/price_id/price to data/paddle_products.json

paddle_integration_audit.webhook_signature: real HMAC-SHA256 over ts:raw_body, constant-time compare; verified INVALID_SIGNATURE rejection works

idempotency_defect.root_cause: _reject() appended event_id to the same ledger _load_processed_event_ids() read without filtering on status, so any transient rejection permanently burned the event_id
idempotency_defect.consequence: a genuinely paid transaction.completed could be rejected once (e.g. catalog not yet synced) and then every Paddle retry would return DUPLICATE_EVENT, losing the real sale permanently while still satisfying 'never double-count'
idempotency_defect.repair: _load_processed_event_ids() now counts only status==ACCEPTED records; rejected events remain fully logged as before
idempotency_defect.anti_duplicate_guarantee: PRESERVED - a true duplicate of an accepted event still returns DUPLICATE_EVENT

paddle_integration_audit.sandbox_evidence: PADDLE_API_BASE is hardcoded to https://api.paddle.com; sandbox is a commented-out constant. A sandbox event cannot carry a live account's webhook signature, so it fails INVALID_SIGNATURE.
paddle_integration_audit.webhook_blocking_gap: PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET unset -> every delivery returns MISSING_SECRET; notification-settings has 0 subscriptions
